# `admin.user.update`

Update a user account

Site admins only. Requires a current If-Match entity tag. Refuses the last active admin.

- Method and path: `POST /admin/users/{user}`
- Scope: `admin:write`
- Kind: `mutation`
- CLI: `rukie admin user update`
- MCP: `admin_user_update`
- Idempotency-Key: required on this mutation
- ETag: served; send it back as If-Match to write safely
